        circuit = QuantumCircuit(qreg)
        circuit.append(RealAmplitudes(num_spins, *params), qreg)

            h_matrix_expval.append(hamiltonian_expval)

        'm_x': lambda params: np.mean([qml.expval(PauliX(i)) for i in range(num_spins)]),

    noise_model.add_quantum_error(QasmQubitNoise(p_bitflip=0.01, p_phaseflip=0.01))

        noise_aware_performance.append(np.abs(h_c - h_c_noise))

    return {'estimated_critical_point': h_c / J,
            'critical_point_error': critical_point_error,
            'observable_accuracy': observable_accuracy,
            'phase_classification_accuracy': phase_classification_accuracy,
            'noise_aware_performance': np.mean(noise_aware_performance)}
